Tech University of Korea, make of the Future of Korean Engineering Technology.

Founded by the government (Ministry of Industry), Tech University of Korea is a leading university for industry-academic cooperation that has contributed to the development of Korea's industry and regional economic growth since its opening in 1998.
Our university has played a leading role in industry-academia cooperation by implementing a family company program with professors, companies, and students for the first time in Korea and introducing an engineering house system.
In addition, as a mecca for fostering talented people with strong competitiveness in the engineering field, we are constantly striving to contribute to the development of Korea's industry and strengthening national competitiveness.
In particular, it has actively responded to changes in current and future industries such as corporate talent universities and future universities and has established itself as the best educational institution in both name and reality.
The vision of TU Korea is a leading university in engineering to create a better future together.

In the future, our university recognizes that engineering technology is the core of Korea's national competitiveness and will operate a flexible and innovative curriculum that meets the needs of industrial sites and students. Through this, we will continue to grow into a university that excellent students prefer, a university that companies want to work with, and a university that becomes a role model for other universities.
Please join us in challenging and growing the future of engineering technology in Korea with TU Korea.
Thank you.
